notes.title: Exciting New! Bride into the Cave Will be Released on 26 APR
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I have some exciting news to share with you all—

[b]The full official version of "Bride into the Cave" will be released on April 26th![/b]

There will be a 20% discount for 14 days. After the release we will donate funds or supplies, from our income, to help young girls in remote areas. 

The official version has evolved significantly from the minigame project during the campus recruitment phase, with major enhancements in art, music, and storyline. If you delve deeper into the story, you will doscover intersting Easter eggs hidden behind the main storyline. 

In the future, if any of you have feedback or suggestions about the game, please don't hesitate to reach out to us. We are eager to listen and learn!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2604410/_/

notes.title: The Release of Bride into the Cave is Postponed
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We'd like to thank you all for the concern and support you have shown for "Bride into the Cave". However, we sincerely apologize that the official release of our game will be slightly delayed by a couple of weeks.

As a group of newcomers, we have received attention far beyond our expectations in the past few months. We never could have imagined we would have gained such a large number of wishlists . Currently, we are working tirelessly to optimize every aspect of the game, and we will announce the final release date of the official version as soon as possible. 

Once again, we thank you for your continued understanding and support!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2604410/_/

notes.title: Announcing Bud Scheme
notes.notes:
Erabit is all about bringing game creativity to life. Besides publishing support, we also help solo devs and small teams with programming, art and other facets of game development. It might be their first time developing a Steam game or publishing on Steam, but their ideas and efforts are truly commendable.

We are pooling these projects into "Bud Scheme", to establish a space for creativity to thrive. We believe that there's nothing more rewarding than doing what you love.

Today we're thrilled to release Wild Legion, the first game from Bud Scheme! Expect more Bud Scheme games in Q1 2024! 

January 26, 2024

notes.title: Bride into the Cave: Official Trailer Revealed
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Greetings from the hub of the Cave!

Since the release of the demo on 24th Nov, the game has received an overwhelming response. We would like to thank every one who has been cheering us on!

Today we have put on a new trailer, very story-rich one, to the Steam page of our game. 


We have prepared for this trailer for over 1 month and some of the upcoming scenes will be revealed in this trailer, giving a small sneak peek into the future development of the game for those who care about us.

We hope you enjoy it!

[b]If you like our game, please add the game to your WISHLIST[/b]. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2604410/_/

notes.title: Bride into the Cave Demo is OUT
notes.notes:
[h1]We're thrilled to announce the release of the official demo for Bride into the Cave![/h1]

When the four of us first came together, we never imagined that we would be able to create a game like this. But here we are, presenting you with our demo and potentially a full version early next year.

The demo features Japanese, Chinese, and English localizations, and includes 2 chapters. We will continue to add more elements and characters to further enrich the story. 

We hope you enjoy it! Feel free to [url=https://discord.gg/ERxAyfCX]join our Discord[/url] if you have any suggestions regarding gameplay or localization. 

And of course,

[h3][b]WISHLIST US![/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2604410/Bride_into_the_Cave/
